breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the gravity vector. The prompt and ground truth establish that the simulation's height is along the Y-axis, requiring gravity to be `(0 -9.81 0)`. The agent repeated the incorrect value from the original prompt, setting the gravity vector to `(0 0 -9.81)`, which would not cause the dam to break correctly in the specified 2D plane.
